title: Cost & Management Accountancy
tagline: Integrated coaching for the ICMAI Foundation examination, focused on costing and management accounting.
overview: The CMA Foundation is the first level of the Cost & Management Accountancy qualification awarded by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI). It suits students interested in how organisations measure cost, price their products and plan performance. As with the CA Foundation, students may register after Class 10 and sit the examination after Class 12, with coaching running alongside the intermediate programme.
highlights: Coverage of all four ICMAI Foundation papers
Regular mock tests in the ICMAI exam pattern
duration: Foundation coaching alongside 2 years of Intermediate
